back.en: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C
back.bm: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C

front.en: When to use the sine rule

back.en: A side and its opposite angle are known, plus one more side or angle
back.bm: Sisi dan sudut bertentangannya diketahui, serta satu lagi sisi atau sudut

back.en: SSA with acute angle and shorter opposite side → angle θ or 180° − θ
back.bm: SSA dengan sudut tirus dan sisi bertentangan lebih pendek → sudut θ atau 180° − θ

front.en: When to use the cosine rule

back.en: Two sides + included angle, or all three sides
back.bm: Dua sisi + sudut kandung, atau ketiga-tiga sisi

back.en: ½ab sin C (two sides and the included angle)
back.bm: ½ab sin C (dua sisi dan sudut kandung)

back.en: √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)], s = ½(a + b + c)
back.bm: √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)], s = ½(a + b + c)

back.en: Opposite the longest side — find it first with the cosine rule
back.bm: Bertentangan dengan sisi terpanjang — cari dahulu dengan petua kosinus

back.en: Negative — so cos A < 0 means A > 90°
back.bm: Negatif — jadi kos A < 0 bermakna A > 90°
